home.tagline: Coordinating relief following the wildfires in Algeria.
home.summary: SOSDZ is a free, community-run platform that coordinates emergency relief in Algeria in response to natural disasters, particularly wildfires. It's built for anyone in Algeria who needs help (food, water, shelter, medical care) and for anyone who wants to help, whether in Algeria or from abroad. There are three ways to use it: report a need, offer your help as a volunteer or delivery driver, or set up a donation collection point near you.

faq.a: SOSDZ is a community-run, volunteer platform that coordinates emergency relief in Algeria: it lets you report a need, offer help, or find a donation collection point, anywhere in the country.

faq.q: How do I request help in Algeria through SOSDZ?
faq.a: Click "I need help" on the homepage, describe your need (food, water, shelter, medical care...) and your location -- nearby volunteers can then see it and offer help.

faq.q: How can I volunteer for disaster relief in Algeria?
faq.a: Click "I want to help" on the homepage to browse nearby reported needs, take charge of a delivery, or become a volunteer driver.

faq.q: How do I set up a donation collection point on SOSDZ?
faq.a: From the "Collection Points" page, click "Add a collection point" and fill in the location, opening hours, and accepted donations -- there's also an option for a collection point abroad.

about.title: About us
about.p1: SOS DZ is a community-run, volunteer, open-source platform built to coordinate mutual aid around wildfires in Algeria: report a need, offer help, and track deliveries in real time.
about.p2: The project isn't affiliated with any administration or official organization -- it's a free, ad-free citizen tool designed to stay usable even on a weak connection.
about.p3: The source code is public; anyone can review how it works or contribute.
about.p4: SOSDZ is an open-source project, developed and deployed voluntarily by Akli HAMRAOUI, an Algerian volunteer, to help coordinate humanitarian aid in Algeria during natural disasters. This is not an official or government platform -- it's an independent citizen initiative.
about.contactLink: A question or a suggestion? Contact the admin.

editor.title: Site publisher
editor.p1: This site is published and developed on a personal, volunteer, non-professional basis (no commercial entity or association behind it). Under French law (LCEN, article 6-III), a non-professional publisher may keep only the name of their hosting provider public (see below); the publisher's full identity remains available confidentially to that host and disclosable to judicial authorities upon request.

project.title: The project
project.p1: SOS DZ is a free, open-source, citizen-run application, built out of solidarity to help coordinate mutual aid during disasters (wildfires, earthquakes, floods, etc.) in Algeria. It does not perform any disaster detection: it is only used to coordinate humanitarian aid once a crisis has been declared by the relevant authorities.
project.p2: The project is entirely free, ad-free, and does not sell or resell any personal data to third parties.
project.p3: SOS DZ is not an official or government platform: it is an independent citizen initiative, developed and deployed by a volunteer.

cgu.title: Terms of Use
cgu.intro: These Terms of Use define the terms of access to and use of the sosdz.org website (the "Site").
cgu.article1Body: Access to the Site is free and open to everyone. No account creation is required to report a need, offer help, or track a delivery.
cgu.article2Body: The Site is used to coordinate mutual aid strictly in the context of a declared disaster. It is not a medical emergency service: in case of immediate danger, contact the relevant official emergency services directly.
cgu.article3Body: Each user is solely responsible for the information they publish. Content that is clearly abusive, dangerous, or inappropriate may be moderated or removed without notice.
cgu.article4Body: The Site is provided "as is", without any warranty as to its availability or accuracy. The creator cannot be held liable for any direct or indirect damage resulting from the use, unavailability, or malfunction of the Site.
cgu.article5Body: The Site is designed to keep the collection of personal data to a strict minimum (no user account, anonymization of sensitive information). The exact details of data processing can be found in the public source code.
cgu.article6Body: The Site's software dependencies are regularly scanned for known vulnerabilities (notably via Snyk), and patched as soon as a fix is available.
cgu.article6Https: All communication between your browser and the Site is encrypted over HTTPS (TLS). The certificate is issued by Let's Encrypt, a free, non-profit certificate authority run by the Internet Security Research Group (ISRG), and renews automatically every 90 days.
cgu.article7Body: These Terms of Use may be changed at any time, in particular to follow the evolution of the project.

cgv.title: Terms of Sale
cgv.body: SOS DZ does not sell any product or service. No commercial transaction takes place on this Site: no paid features, no subscriptions, no advertising. These Terms of Sale are mentioned for information purposes only and do not actually apply, since the Site has no commercial activity.

solidarity.title: A solidarity project, not a company
solidarity.p1: This project was built on a volunteer basis by a single developer, out of solidarity with people affected by disasters in Algeria, with no profit motive whatsoever.
solidarity.p2: If an association or organization in Algeria wants to take over, continue, or deploy this project on the ground -- including hosting the platform itself directly in Algeria -- you can reach us through the form below: we can give you access to the project's code and data, and help you deploy and host it in Algeria.
